MainTex.label: Absorption Reference Map
MainTex.tooltip: RGB multiplies BaseColor and GlassAbsorptionColor to define transmission after GlassAbsorptionDistance in meters. White is no absorption. A independently multiplies geometric coverage; it does not control optical transmission or Fresnel.

BaseColor.label: Absorption Reference Color
BaseColor.tooltip: Multiplies MainTex RGB and GlassAbsorptionColor as the Beer-Lambert reference color. White is clear. It never tints the dielectric interface reflection or creates diffuse paint.

IOR.tooltip: Air/glass IOR for the locally parallel slab. Controls both GGX reflection energy and refracted path. 1 removes dielectric reflection and bending. No nested media, internal-camera medium tracking or dispersion.

Roughness.tooltip: Perceptual roughness shared by compensated GGX reflection and the finite nine-tap elliptical screen-transmission filter. AA and anisotropy affect both. Transmission filtering is a bounded approximation, not an exact microfacet BTDF.

Coverage.tooltip: Geometric area coverage only. Keep 1 for intact glass: optical transparency comes from Fresnel and absorption, not alpha fading. Lower values remove that fraction of reflection, emission, absorption and refraction together.

CullOption.tooltip: Default Back draws one glass interface per visible closed surface. Off can draw a slab from both sides but does not solve multiple overlapping glass interfaces. This material does not track nested media or camera-inside-glass transitions.

DebugView.tooltip: 0 beauty; 1 slab reflection budget; 2 RGB transmission budget; 3 valid screen-refraction weight; 4 shading normal; 5 native light attenuation. Debug outputs replace the background under coverage; Add is suppressed.

properties.name: GlassThicknessMap
properties.label: Thickness Map
properties.tooltip: Linear red channel multiplies GlassThickness. Independent UV scale/offset; shares RoughnessMap filtering/wrapping. This is supplied thickness, not measured back-face depth.

properties.name: GlassThickness
properties.label: Glass Thickness (m)
properties.tooltip: Local normal thickness in world meters, multiplied by Thickness Map R. The inside path is thickness/cos(refracted angle). Controls Beer absorption and parallel-slab lateral displacement, not vertex movement; object scale does not silently rescale it.

properties.name: GlassAbsorptionColor
properties.label: Absorption Color At Distance
properties.tooltip: Transmission color at GlassAbsorptionDistance, multiplied by MainTex RGB and BaseColor. Beer-Lambert absorption is path-length dependent; RGB is bounded to 0..1, A is ignored. White causes no absorption. No colored shadow casting.

properties.name: GlassAbsorptionDistance
properties.label: Absorption Reference Distance (m)
properties.tooltip: World-meter distance at which the combined absorption reference color is reached. Larger distance means weaker absorption at the same thickness. This is independent of geometric coverage.

properties.name: UseSceneRefraction
properties.label: Use Scene Refraction
properties.tooltip: Request opaque scene color/depth from companion 0.5.0 for finite slab refraction. Off, missing companion, unsupported camera or invalid depth/UV keeps the current unshifted background with the same RGB absorption and GGX reflection. No GrabPass, SSR or shadow-map rendering.

properties.name: GlassBufferResolution
properties.label: Refraction Buffer Resolution
properties.tooltip: 1 Full, 2 Half. Visible glass materials share one camera color/depth copy at the highest requested resolution. Only scene refraction uses these buffers; no visible consumer means no automatic lease.

properties.name: GlassDepthBias
properties.label: Refraction Depth Guard (m)
properties.tooltip: Positive world-meter separation required between the glass exit and sampled opaque depth. Rejects foreground leakage and unstable depth discontinuities; rejected pixels keep unshifted transmission, not stretched screen-edge colors.

properties.name: GlassEdgeFade
properties.label: Refraction Screen Edge Fade
properties.tooltip: Normalized UV margin that smoothly returns screen refraction to unshifted transmission near the screen boundary. Out-of-bounds candidates are rejected, never clamped across the screen edge.
